name: ESP32-H2

strapping.2: Listed as a strapping pin by the ESP-IDF stable GPIO summary, but NOT by ESP32-H2 datasheet v1.3 (which lists only GPIO8, GPIO9, GPIO25). GPIO2 is MTMS. Exact strapping function UNCONFIRMED - kept for safety.
strapping.3: Listed as a strapping pin by the ESP-IDF stable GPIO summary, but NOT by ESP32-H2 datasheet v1.3. GPIO3 is MTDO. Exact strapping function UNCONFIRMED - kept for safety.
strapping.8: Chip boot mode (Joint Download Boot requires GPIO8=1 with GPIO9=0; any value for SPI Boot) and UART0 ROM message printing control with EFUSE_UART_PRINT_CONTROL / LP_AON_STORE4_REG[0]. Default floating.
strapping.9: Chip boot mode select: 1 = SPI Boot (default, internal weak pull-up), 0 = Joint Download Boot (USB-Serial-JTAG / UART download).
strapping.25: JTAG signal source select, used with EFUSE_DIS_PAD_JTAG / EFUSE_DIS_USB_JTAG / EFUSE_JTAG_SEL_ENABLE (only consulted when JTAG_SEL_ENABLE is burned: low = JTAG on GPIO2-GPIO5, high = USB_SERIAL_JTAG). Default floating; datasheet: 'This pin does not have any internal pull resistors and the strapping value must be controlled by the external circuit'.

psram.condition: Not applicable: neither the ESP-IDF GPIO summary nor the ESP32-H2 datasheet v1.3 describes a PSRAM interface for this chip.

usb_jtag.note: GPIO26 = USB_D-, GPIO27 = USB_D+. ESP-IDF: 'GPIO 26 and 27 are used by USB-Serial-JTAG by default. In order to use them as GPIOs, USB-Serial-JTAG will be disabled by the drivers.'

notes: STRAPPING DISCREPANCY: ESP-IDF stable GPIO summary lists GPIO2, GPIO3, GPIO8, GPIO9, GPIO25; datasheet v1.3 says 'Three strapping pins: GPIO8, GPIO9, and GPIO25'. The union is used; GPIO2/GPIO3 descriptions are marked unconfirmed.

flash_spi: ESP-IDF: 'GPIO15-21 are usually used for SPI flash'. Per datasheet v1.3 all current variants (ESP32-H2FH2S, ESP32-H2FH4S) have in-package flash; on SiP-flash variants GPIO15-GPIO21 are dedicated to the SiP flash and not brought out, and GPIO6-GPIO7 are also not brought out. Only GPIO0-GPIO5, GPIO8-GPIO14, GPIO22-GPIO27 are available to users (datasheet: '19 GPIOs'). An auditor should flag any use of GPIO6, GPIO7, GPIO15-GPIO21 on these packages.

input_only / no_internal_pull are empty: ESP-IDF GPIO summary lists none for this chip (the 'input-only GPIOs 34-39' remarks on the page are for the original ESP32); datasheet IO MUX types are I/O/T; TRM v1.2 Register 6.20 IO_MUX_GPIOn_REG (n: 0-27) provides FUN_WPU/FUN_WPD for every GPIO. The GPIO25 'no internal pull resistors' sentence refers to its strapping/reset state.

jtag pins: GPIO2 = MTMS, GPIO3 = MTDO, GPIO4 = MTCK, GPIO5 = MTDI (ESP-IDF configure-other-jtag page and datasheet IO MUX table; note H2 ordering differs from C3/C6). JTAG defaults to USB_SERIAL_JTAG; burning DIS_USB_JTAG moves it to GPIO2-GPIO5.

No ADC2: ADC1 CH0-CH4 on GPIO1-GPIO5. ESP-IDF stable ADC oneshot hardware limitations for H2 contain only the RNG and oneshot/continuous exclusivity notes. GPIO10/GPIO11 are analog-comparator (ANA_CMPR_CH0) reference / non-inverting input.
RTC/deep-sleep wake: GPIO7-GPIO14 are RTC GPIOs; GPIO7 cannot be used for external wake-up (not led out). Other GPIOs only wake from Light-sleep.
Radio: no Wi-Fi. Datasheet: 'Bluetooth Low Energy and IEEE 802.15.4' - no Bluetooth Classic.
Data sourced from ESP-IDF stable = v6.1 docs, ESP32-H2 datasheet v1.3, ESP32-H2 TRM v1.2, retrieved 2026-10-28.
